evidences.content: Silas authored SIGEC v2, a fiscal intelligence engine that indexed 1.1M+ ARTs on a SHA-256 blockchain, and led its modernization in parallel.
SIGEC v2 includes a Sentinel-2 to PostGIS pipeline for hydrological monitoring of 20 reservoirs using NDWI.
SIGEC v2 uses NetworkX and TSP routing across 224 municipalities in Piauí.
SIGEC v2 runs on Flask, FastAPI, Angular 17, PostgreSQL 17 and PostGIS, deployed as 8 systemd services in production, with an orchestrator that uses the OpenAI and Claude APIs.
Silas authored FiscalBot, an operational Telegram bot that sends automated alerts and runs a mass ART pipeline.
Silas authored SistemaCrea, an ERP modernization on Jakarta EE: a Maven multi-module EAR, e-MEC integration covering 4,328 IES, JSF with PrimeFaces 13 and Payara 6.
Worked as Technology and Information Security Advisor at CREA-PI. The role ended in July 2026.
Core skills: Java EE 8, Python, TypeScript, Angular, FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, Cloudflare Tunnel, Linux/systemd and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Specialties: legacy modernization (Java EE), geospatial AI, blockchain traceability, DevSecOps and fiscal intelligence systems.
